verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair axis for an operating system, so the story applies. However, nothing in the pack documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The PowerShell CLI reference (windows-probe-4) is only a scripting building block. System restore and last known good configuration (windows-comm-2) are OS-level recovery, not rollback of automations, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
